source_title: The Geopolitics of Critical Minerals: Navigating Scarcity, Concentration, and Control
data_period: research published 2026-11-03; underlying mineral snapshot dates undisclosed
business_context: 원문은 23개 핵심광물에 대한 매장·채굴·정련·제조 및 국제 소유망을 분석한다. Exhibit 3은 광물별 채굴과 정련 시장 집중도를 두 축에 배치하고 중국의 수출통제 대상 여부를 표시한다. 정련 집중도가 높은 광물은 채굴국이 다변화되어도 실질 공급망 위험이 남을 수 있다.
key_message: 핵심광물의 채굴과 정련은 서로 다른 국가·기업에 집중될 수 있어 공급망 다변화 전략은 생산국뿐 아니라 정련의 집중도와 수출통제 대상 여부를 함께 평가해야 한다.
encoding: x=extraction index, y=processing index; point marker and color encode source-figure leader/control classification; one point per mineral. Both axes span 0–1 with 0.5 horizontal reference. The source labels many points; template uses data-driven placements with manual legibility offsets.

data_spec.denominator: mineral-specific concentration definition not numerically disclosed; see official methodology
data_spec.period: research published 2026-11-03; underlying mineral snapshot dates undisclosed
data_spec.uncertainty: coordinate ±0.04, based on manual interpretation of official 499-pixel preview
data_spec.sampling: 20 visually legible points out of chart; one or more labels may be omitted, not exhaustive

data_recipe: Secure minerals and jurisdiction-level extraction/processing market shares for the same period.
Compute concentration using the source-defined index, not raw percentages.
Mark each mineral by the leader and official export-control policy at the snapshot date.
Plot x extraction / y processing on 0–1 scales; annotate selected risk minerals.
Validate the raw point coordinates against the original source dataset before claiming research-grade accuracy.
message_conditions: Only compare x and y if underlying concentration-index methodology matches.
Do not interpret estimated coordinates as directly reported values or exact current policy classification.
Labels overlap, original downloadable data unknown; direct original image was viewed but fidelity of complete chart remains unverified.
